sentences.text:
on 15 November,
2023
 The Honourable Sri Justice K.Surender
 Criminal Petition No.11205 Of 2023
Order:

This Criminal Petition, under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (for short 'Cr.P.C.') is filed by the petitioners/A1 and A2 seeking to quash the proceedings against them in C.C.No.596 of 2023 on the file of I Additional Judicial Magistrate of First Class at Kothagudem.

entities.text: I Additional Judicial Magistrate of First Class at Kothagudem
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The offences alleged against the petitioners/A1 and A2 are punishable under Section 498A of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.

2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners/A1 and A2 and learned Assistant Public Prosecutor representing the respondent No.1-State.
3.
Perusal of the record discloses that there are no grounds to quash the proceedings against the petitioners/A1 and A2 in the subject C.C.
The petitioners/A1 and A2 have to undergo trial to prove their case.

4. At this stage, learned counsel for the petitioners/A1 and A2 seeks permission of this Court to dispense with the attendance/appearance of the petitioners/A1 and A2 in the subject C.C.
5.
As seen from the record, the petitioner/A1 is an employee working in UBI and the petitioner/A2 is aged about 70 years with old age ailments.

6. Therefore, the petitioners/A1 and A2 are at liberty to file an application under Section 205 of Cr.P.C., to be represented by a counsel, before the trial Court and the same shall be considered by the trial Court, by imposing conditions, without hindrance to the trial.
7. With the above observation, the Criminal Petition is disposed of.
Miscellaneous applications pending, if any, shall stand closed.
